messages.content: how to get the information of an interface?

function.name: telemetry_flowrules_interfaceInfo_get
function.description: Retrieves specified telemetry information for a network interface within a given fabric, node, and pod, filtered by the interface and information types. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

fabricName.description: The name of the fabric to limit the nodes pertaining to the given fabric name.

nodeId.description: The identifier of the node to limit the results pertaining to the given node ID.

podId.description: The identifier of the pod to limit the results pertaining to the given pod ID.

interfaceType.description: The type of the interface to limit the results pertaining to the given interface type.

infoType.description: The type of information to retrieve about the interface.

message.content:
To retrieve telemetry data for a specific interface you’ll call the **`telemetry_flowrules_interfaceInfo_get`** function.  
It requires four arguments:

| Argument | Description | Allowed Values |
|----------|-------------|----------------|
| `fabricName` | Name of the fabric (e.g., `"prod-fabric"`). | Any string |
| `nodeId` | Identifier of the node (e.g., `101`). | Integer |
| `podId` | Identifier of the pod (e.g., `1`). | Integer |
| `interfaceType` | Type of interface you’re querying. | `"svi"`, `"ethernet"`, `"loopback"`, `"port-channel"` |
| `infoType` | What kind of data you want. | `"interfaces"`, `"status"`, `"statistics"`, `"errors"` |

### Example Call

```python
response = telemetry_flowrules_interfaceInfo_get(
    fabricName="prod-fabric",
    nodeId=101,
    podId=1,
    interfaceType="ethernet",
    infoType="statistics"
)
print(response)
```

This will return the statistics for all Ethernet interfaces on node 101 in pod 1 of the “prod‑fabric” fabric.

Feel free to replace the argument values with those relevant to your environment. If you need help constructing a specific query, let me know the fabric name, node ID, pod ID, interface type, and the type of information you’re after.
